title: Understanding Terminal Potential Difference
text: The terminal potential difference (V) is the voltage available to the external circuit. It equals the EMF minus the voltage lost across the internal resistance. Use the formula: V = EMF - Ir

title: Substitute the Values
text: Substitute: V = 24 V - (4 A)(0.5 ohm) = 24 V - 2 V = 22 V
